public import bitio = "./bitio.qui"

class Model()
    int[][] frequencies := array(256, fill = array(257, fill = 1))
    totals := array(256, fill = 257)
    rescales := array(256, fill = 0)
    used := array(256, fill = false)

    int[] interval(int context, int symbol)
        cumulative := 0
        for: index < symbol
            cumulative += frequencies[context][index]
        return [cumulative, frequencies[context][symbol]]

    int[] locate(int context, int value)
        symbol := 0
        cumulative := 0
        while value >= cumulative + frequencies[context][symbol]
            cumulative += frequencies[context][symbol]
            symbol += 1
        return [symbol, cumulative, frequencies[context][symbol]]

    void .update(int context, int symbol)
        frequencies[context][symbol] += 32
        totals[context] += 32
        if totals[context] >= 8192
            totals[context] = 0
            for: index < 257
                frequencies[context][index] = (frequencies[context][index] + 1) / 2
                totals[context] += frequencies[context][index]
            rescales[context] += 1

void emit(bitio.Writer &writer, int &follow, int bit)
    .writer.write(bit, 1)
    for _ < follow
        .writer.write(1 - bit, 1)
    follow = 0

class Encoded(int[] data, int[] stats)

Encoded encode(int[] data)
    writer := bitio.Writer()
    model := Model()
    low := 0
    high := 65535
    follow := 0
    context := 10
    for: position <= int(#data)
        symbol := if position < int(#data) then data[position] else 256
        model.used[context] = true
        range := model.interval(context, symbol)
        span := high - low + 1
        high = low + span * (range[0] + range[1]) / model.totals[context] - 1
        low += span * range[0] / model.totals[context]
        while true
            if high < 32768
                emit(&writer, &follow, 0)
            elif low >= 32768
                emit(&writer, &follow, 1)
                low -= 32768
                high -= 32768
            elif low >= 16384 and high < 49152
                follow += 1
                low -= 16384
                high -= 16384
            else
                break
            low *= 2
            high = 2 * high + 1
        if symbol != 256
            .model.update(context, symbol)
            context = symbol
    follow += 1
    emit(&writer, &follow, if low < 16384 then 0 else 1)
    contexts := 0
    rescales := 0
    for: index < 256
        if model.used[index]
            contexts += 1
        rescales += model.rescales[index]
    return Encoded(writer.finish(), [writer.bit_count, contexts, rescales])

bitio.Decoded decode(int[] payload, int original)
    reader := bitio.Reader(payload, true)
    model := Model()
    int[] output := []
    low := 0
    high := 65535
    value := .reader.read(16)
    context := 10
    while true
        span := high - low + 1
        quantile := ((value - low + 1) * model.totals[context] - 1) / span
        range := model.locate(context, quantile)
        symbol := range[0]
        high = low + span * (range[1] + range[2]) / model.totals[context] - 1
        low += span * range[1] / model.totals[context]
        while true
            if high >= 32768
                if low >= 32768
                    low -= 32768
                    high -= 32768
                    value -= 32768
                elif low >= 16384 and high < 49152
                    low -= 16384
                    high -= 16384
                    value -= 16384
                else
                    break
            low *= 2
            high = 2 * high + 1
            next_bit := .reader.read(1)
            value = 2 * value + next_bit
        if symbol == 256
            if int(#output) < original
                return bitio.failure("early_end", int(#output))
            return bitio.Decoded(output)
        if int(#output) == original
            return bitio.failure("overrun", int(#output))
        output = output.append(symbol)
        .model.update(context, symbol)
        context = symbol
    return bitio.Decoded(output)

int power_two(int exponent)
    result := 1
    for _ < exponent
        result *= 2
    return result

int bits(int value)
    count := 0
    while value > 0
        count += 1
        value /= 2
    return count

string key(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return fields.join(",")

class DecodeError(string kind, int position)
class Decoded(int[] data, DecodeError[] problems := [])

Decoded failure(string kind, int position)
    return Decoded([], [DecodeError(kind, position)])

class Writer()
    int[] data := []
    partial := 0
    used := 0
    bit_count := 0

    void .write(int value, int width)
        for: width - 1 >= shift >= 0
            partial = partial * 2 + value / power_two(shift) % 2
            used += 1
            if used == 8
                data = data.append(partial)
                partial = 0
                used = 0
        bit_count += width

    int[] finish()
        return if used > 0 then data.append(partial * power_two(8 - used)) else data

class Reader(int[] payload, zero_fill := false)
    position := 0
    DecodeError[] problems := []

    bool failed()
        return #problems > 0

    int .read(int width, output_position := 0)
        if failed()
            return 0
        limit := 8 * int(#payload)
        if not zero_fill and position + width > limit
            problems = [DecodeError("end_of_data", output_position)]
            return 0
        value := 0
        for _ < width
            value *= 2
            if position < limit
                value += payload[position / 8] / power_two(7 - position % 8) % 2
            position += 1
        return value

bool less(int[] first, int[] second)
    return first[0] < second[0] or (first[0] == second[0] and first[1] < second[1])

int[] tree_lengths(int[] frequencies)
    lengths := array(#frequencies, fill = 0)
    int[][] nodes := []
    int[] active := []
    for: symbol < int(#frequencies)
        if frequencies[symbol] > 0
            active = active.append(int(#nodes))
            nodes = nodes.append([frequencies[symbol], symbol, symbol, -1, -1])
    if #active == 0
        return lengths
    if #active == 1
        lengths[nodes[active[0]][2]] = 1
        return lengths
    while #active > 1
        int[] chosen := []
        for _ < 2
            best := 0
            for: 1 <= index < int(#active)
                if less(nodes[active[index]], nodes[active[best]])
                    best = index
            chosen = chosen.append(active[best])
            active = active[0:<best].concat(active[best + 1:<int(#active)])
        first := nodes[chosen[0]]
        second := nodes[chosen[1]]
        active = active.append(int(#nodes))
        nodes = nodes.append([first[0] + second[0], if first[1] < second[1] then first[1] else second[1], -1, chosen[0], chosen[1]])
    int[][] pending := [[active[0], 0]]
    while #pending != 0
        item := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        node := nodes[item[0]]
        if node[2] >= 0
            lengths[node[2]] = item[1]
        else
            pending = pending.append([node[3], item[1] + 1]).append([node[4], item[1] + 1])
    return lengths

class Lengths(int[] values, int halvings)

Lengths limited_lengths(int[] frequencies, int maximum)
    weights := frequencies
    halvings := 0
    lengths := tree_lengths(weights)
    longest := 0
    for length := lengths[]
        if length > longest
            longest = length
    while longest > maximum
        for: index < int(#weights)
            weights[index] = (weights[index] + 1) / 2
        halvings += 1
        lengths = tree_lengths(weights)
        longest = 0
        for length := lengths[]
            if length > longest
                longest = length
    return Lengths(lengths, halvings)

int power_two(int exponent)
    result := 1
    for _ < exponent
        result *= 2
    return result

int[] canonical(int[] lengths)
    int[] ordered := []
    for: symbol < int(#lengths)
        if lengths[symbol] > 0
            place := int(#ordered)
            ordered = ordered.append(symbol)
            while place > 0 and lengths[symbol] < lengths[ordered[place - 1]]
                ordered[place] = ordered[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            ordered[place] = symbol
    codes := array(#lengths, fill = 0)
    code := 0
    previous := 0
    for: index < int(#ordered)
        symbol := ordered[index]
        if index > 0
            code = (code + 1) * power_two(lengths[symbol] - previous)
        codes[symbol] = code
        previous = lengths[symbol]
    return codes

public import bitio = "./bitio.qui"

class Token(int literal, distance := 0, length := 0)

int[] positions(map<string, int[]> prefixes, string name)
    match prefixes.get(name)
        int[] stored
            return stored
        none
            return []

Token[] tokenize(int[] data, int offset_bits, int length_bits)
    window := bitio.power_two(offset_bits)
    lookahead := bitio.power_two(length_bits) + 2
    position := 0
    Token[] tokens := []
    map<string, int[]> prefixes
    while position < int(#data)
        distance := 0
        longest := 0
        limit := if lookahead < int(#data) - position then lookahead else int(#data) - position
        if limit >= 3
            name := bitio.key(data[position:<position + 3])
            candidates := positions(prefixes, name)
            for start := candidates[::-1][]
                candidate_distance := position - start
                if candidate_distance > window
                    break
                length := 3
                while length < limit and data[position + length] == data[position + length - candidate_distance]
                    length += 1
                if length > longest
                    distance = candidate_distance
                    longest = length
                if longest == limit
                    break
        consumed := 1
        if longest >= 3
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(-1, distance, longest))
            consumed = longest
        else
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(data[position]))
        end := if position + consumed < int(#data) - 2 then position + consumed else int(#data) - 2
        for: position <= start < end
            name := bitio.key(data[start:<start + 3])
            candidates := positions(prefixes, name)
            .prefixes.set(name, candidates.append(start))
        position += consumed
    return tokens

bitio.Decoded copy_match(int[] output, int distance, int length, int original)
    if distance > int(#output)
        return bitio.failure("bad_offset", int(#output))
    if int(#output) + length > original
        return bitio.failure("overrun", int(#output))
    for _ < length
        output = output.append(output[int(#output) - distance])
    return bitio.Decoded(output)

public import bitio = "./bitio.qui"

map<string, int> encoding_dictionary()
    map<string, int> result
    for: value < 256
        .result.set("{value}", value)
    return result

int lookup(map<string, int> values, string name)
    match values.get(name)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return -1

int[][] decoding_dictionary()
    int[][] result := []
    for: value < 256
        result = result.append([value])
    return result.concat([[], []])

void emit(bitio.Writer &writer, int[] &stats, int &since_clear, int code, length := 0)
    width := bitio.bits(258 + since_clear)
    if width > 12
        width = 12
    .writer.write(code, width)
    stats[0] += 1
    stats[width - 7] += 1
    if length > stats[6]
        stats[6] = length
    if code == 256
        stats[1] += 1
        since_clear = 0
    else
        since_clear += 1

class Encoded(int[] data, int[] stats)

Encoded encode(int[] data)
    writer := bitio.Writer()
    dictionary := encoding_dictionary()
    next_code := 258
    since_clear := 0
    stats := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    emit(&writer, &stats, &since_clear, 256)
    int[] sequence := []
    for value := data[]
        extended := sequence.append(value)
        extended_key := bitio.key(extended)
        if lookup(dictionary, extended_key) >= 0
            sequence = extended
        else
            emit(&writer, &stats, &since_clear, lookup(dictionary, bitio.key(sequence)), int(#sequence))
            .dictionary.set(extended_key, next_code)
            next_code += 1
            if next_code == 4096
                emit(&writer, &stats, &since_clear, 256)
                dictionary = encoding_dictionary()
                next_code = 258
            sequence = [value]
    if #sequence > 0
        emit(&writer, &stats, &since_clear, lookup(dictionary, bitio.key(sequence)), int(#sequence))
    emit(&writer, &stats, &since_clear, 257)
    return Encoded(writer.finish(), stats)

bitio.Decoded decode(int[] payload, int original)
    reader := bitio.Reader(payload)
    dictionary := decoding_dictionary()
    previous := -1
    since_clear := 0
    int[] output := []
    while true
        count := since_clear
        width := bitio.bits(258 + count)
        if width > 12
            width = 12
        code := .reader.read(width, int(#output))
        if reader.failed()
            return bitio.Decoded([], reader.problems)
        if code == 256
            dictionary = decoding_dictionary()
            previous = -1
            since_clear = 0
            continue
        since_clear += 1
        if code == 257
            if int(#output) < original
                return bitio.failure("early_end", int(#output))
            return bitio.Decoded(output)
        if count == 3838
            return bitio.failure("bad_code", int(#output))
        next_code := int(#dictionary)
        int[] sequence := []
        if previous < 0
            if code >= 256
                return bitio.failure("bad_code", int(#output))
            sequence = dictionary[code]
        elif code < next_code
            sequence = dictionary[code]
        elif code == next_code
            sequence = dictionary[previous].append(dictionary[previous][0])
        else
            return bitio.failure("bad_code", int(#output))
        if int(#output) + int(#sequence) > original
            return bitio.failure("overrun", int(#output))
        output = output.concat(sequence)
        if previous >= 0
            dictionary = dictionary.append(dictionary[previous].append(sequence[0]))
        previous = code
    return bitio.Decoded(output)

import bitio = "./bitio.qui"
import lzw = "./lzw.qui"
import lz77 = "./lz77.qui"
import huffman = "./huffman.qui"
import arithmetic = "./arith_coder.qui"

string[] method_names()
    return ["STORE", "LZW", "LZ77", "LZH", "ARITH"]

string[] status_names()
    return ["ok", "repaired", "checksum", "error", "unsupported", "truncated", "bad_header"]

string integers(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return fields.join(" ")

string ratio(int compressed, int original)
    return if original > 0 then "{1000 * compressed / original}" else "-"

string method_name(int number)
    names := method_names()
    return if number < 5 then names[number] else "#{number}"

string byte_text(int[] values)
    bytes := nat8(values)
    packed := bin(bytes)
    result := string.from_utf8(packed)
    return result

int[] read_bytes(string path)
    contents := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    return contents.codepoints()

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

int decimal(string text)
    value := int(text)
    return value

int adler(int[] data)
    first := 1
    second := 0
    for value := data[]
        first = (first + value) % 65521
        second = (second + first) % 65521
    return second * 65536 + first

int modular_power(int base, int exponent)
    result := 1
    while exponent > 0
        if exponent % 2 == 1
            result = result * base % 65521
        base = base * base % 65521
        exponent /= 2
    return result

int modulo(int value, int divisor)
    result := value % divisor
    return if result < 0 then result + divisor else result

class Repaired(int[] data, int[] record)

Repaired[] repair_byte(int[] data, int stored, int computed)
    difference_a := modulo(stored % 65536 - computed % 65536, 65521)
    difference_b := modulo(stored / 65536 - computed / 65536, 65521)
    delta := 0
    if difference_a >= 1 and difference_a <= 255
        delta = difference_a
    elif difference_a >= 65266 and difference_a <= 65520
        delta = difference_a - 65521
    else
        return []
    inverse := modular_power(modulo(delta, 65521), 65519)
    distance := difference_b * inverse % 65521
    if distance < 1 or distance > int(#data)
        return []
    position := int(#data) - distance
    before := data[position]
    after := before + delta
    if after < 0 or after > 255
        return []
    repaired := data
    repaired[position] = after
    if adler(repaired) != stored
        return []
    return [Repaired(repaired, [position, before, after])]

class DecodeResult(int[] data, kind := "", position := 0)

int[] fixed_lengths(int count)
    width := bitio.bits(count - 1)
    shorter := bitio.power_two(width) - count
    int[] result := []
    for: symbol < count
        result = result.append(if symbol < shorter then width - 1 else width)
    return result

void write_table(bitio.Writer &writer, int[] lengths)
    symbol := 0
    while symbol < int(#lengths)
        if lengths[symbol] > 0
            .writer.write(lengths[symbol], 4)
            symbol += 1
        else
            run := 1
            while run < 256 and symbol + run < int(#lengths) and lengths[symbol + run] == 0
                run += 1
            .writer.write(0, 4)
            .writer.write(run - 1, 8)
            symbol += run

int[] read_table(bitio.Reader &reader, int count)
    int[] lengths := []
    while int(#lengths) < count
        length := .reader.read(4)
        if reader.failed()
            return []
        if length > 0
            lengths = lengths.append(length)
        else
            run := .reader.read(8)
            if reader.failed()
                return []
            run += 1
            if int(#lengths) + run > count
                reader.problems = [bitio.DecodeError("bad_table", 0)]
                return []
            for _ < run
                lengths = lengths.append(0)
    used := 0
    only := 0
    kraft := 0
    for length := lengths[]
        if length > 0
            used += 1
            only = length
            kraft += bitio.power_two(15 - length)
    if (used == 1 and only != 1) or (used >= 2 and kraft != 32768)
        reader.problems = [bitio.DecodeError("bad_table", 0)]
    return lengths

class SymbolReader(int[] lengths)
    codes := huffman.canonical(lengths)
    maximum := 0
    for length := lengths[]
        if length > maximum
            maximum = length

    int read_symbol(bitio.Reader &reader, int position)
        if maximum == 0
            reader.problems = [bitio.DecodeError("bad_code", position)]
            return -1
        code := 0
        for: 1 <= width <= maximum
            next_bit := .reader.read(1, position)
            if reader.failed()
                return -1
            code = code * 2 + next_bit
            for: symbol < int(#lengths)
                if lengths[symbol] == width and codes[symbol] == code
                    return symbol
        reader.problems = [bitio.DecodeError("bad_code", position)]
        return -1

int[] encode_lz(lz77.Token[] tokens, int offset_bits, int length_bits)
    writer := bitio.Writer()
    for token := tokens[]
        if token.literal >= 0
            .writer.write(0, 1)
            .writer.write(token.literal, 8)
        else
            .writer.write(1, 1)
            .writer.write(token.distance - 1, offset_bits)
            .writer.write(token.length - 3, length_bits)
    return writer.finish()

DecodeResult copy_match(int[] output, int distance, int length, int original)
    result := lz77.copy_match(output, distance, length, original)
    if #result.problems > 0
        return DecodeResult([], result.problems[0].kind, result.problems[0].position)
    return DecodeResult(result.data)

DecodeResult decode_lz(int[] payload, int original, int offset_bits, int length_bits)
    reader := bitio.Reader(payload)
    int[] output := []
    while int(#output) < original
        flag := .reader.read(1, int(#output))
        if reader.failed()
            return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
        if flag == 0
            value := .reader.read(8, int(#output))
            if reader.failed()
                return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
            output = output.append(value)
        else
            distance := .reader.read(offset_bits, int(#output))
            length := .reader.read(length_bits, int(#output))
            if reader.failed()
                return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
            copied := copy_match(output, distance + 1, length + 3, original)
            if copied.kind != ""
                return copied
            output = copied.data
    return DecodeResult(output)

void write_tokens(bitio.Writer &writer, lz77.Token[] tokens, int[] literal_lengths, int[] distance_lengths)
    literal_codes := huffman.canonical(literal_lengths)
    distance_codes := huffman.canonical(distance_lengths)
    for token := tokens[]
        if token.literal >= 0
            .writer.write(literal_codes[token.literal], literal_lengths[token.literal])
        else
            symbol := 256 + token.length - 3
            .writer.write(literal_codes[symbol], literal_lengths[symbol])
            offset := token.distance - 1
            slot := bitio.bits(offset)
            .writer.write(distance_codes[slot], distance_lengths[slot])
            if slot >= 2
                .writer.write(offset - bitio.power_two(slot - 1), slot - 1)

class Params(int offset_bits, int length_bits, int max_code_length)
class LzhEncoded(int[] data, int[] stats, int[] slots)

LzhEncoded encode_lzh(lz77.Token[] tokens, Params params)
    literal_count := 256 + bitio.power_two(params.length_bits)
    distance_count := params.offset_bits + 1
    literal_frequencies := array(nat(literal_count), fill = 0)
    distance_frequencies := array(nat(distance_count), fill = 0)
    for token := tokens[]
        symbol := if token.literal >= 0 then token.literal else 256 + token.length - 3
        literal_frequencies[symbol] += 1
        if token.distance > 0
            distance_frequencies[bitio.bits(token.distance - 1)] += 1
    literal_limited := huffman.limited_lengths(literal_frequencies, params.max_code_length)
    distance_limited := huffman.limited_lengths(distance_frequencies, params.max_code_length)
    literal_lengths := literal_limited.values
    distance_lengths := distance_limited.values
    fixed := bitio.Writer()
    .fixed.write(0, 1)
    write_tokens(&fixed, tokens, fixed_lengths(literal_count), fixed_lengths(distance_count))
    fixed_bits := fixed.bit_count - 1
    dynamic := bitio.Writer()
    .dynamic.write(1, 1)
    write_table(&dynamic, literal_lengths)
    write_table(&dynamic, distance_lengths)
    table_bits := dynamic.bit_count - 1
    write_tokens(&dynamic, tokens, literal_lengths, distance_lengths)
    code_bits := dynamic.bit_count - 1 - table_bits
    use_fixed := fixed_bits <= table_bits + code_bits
    litlen_used := 0
    litlen_max := 0
    offset_used := 0
    offset_max := 0
    for length := literal_lengths[]
        if length > 0
            litlen_used += 1
        if length > litlen_max
            litlen_max = length
    for length := distance_lengths[]
        if length > 0
            offset_used += 1
        if length > offset_max
            offset_max = length
    stats := [fixed_bits, table_bits, code_bits, literal_limited.halvings + distance_limited.halvings, litlen_used, litlen_max, offset_used, offset_max, if use_fixed then 0 else 1]
    return LzhEncoded(if use_fixed then fixed.finish() else dynamic.finish(), stats, distance_frequencies)

DecodeResult decode_lzh(int[] payload, int original, int offset_bits, int length_bits)
    reader := bitio.Reader(payload)
    literal_count := 256 + bitio.power_two(length_bits)
    distance_count := offset_bits + 1
    mode := .reader.read(1)
    if reader.failed()
        return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
    int[] literal_lengths := []
    int[] distance_lengths := []
    if mode == 1
        literal_lengths = read_table(&reader, literal_count)
        if reader.failed()
            return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
        distance_lengths = read_table(&reader, distance_count)
        if reader.failed()
            return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
    else
        literal_lengths = fixed_lengths(literal_count)
        distance_lengths = fixed_lengths(distance_count)
    literal_reader := SymbolReader(literal_lengths)
    distance_reader := SymbolReader(distance_lengths)
    int[] output := []
    while int(#output) < original
        symbol := literal_reader.read_symbol(&reader, int(#output))
        if reader.failed()
            return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
        if symbol < 256
            output = output.append(symbol)
        else
            slot := distance_reader.read_symbol(&reader, int(#output))
            if reader.failed()
                return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
            offset := slot
            if slot >= 2
                extra := .reader.read(slot - 1, int(#output))
                if reader.failed()
                    return DecodeResult([], reader.problems[0].kind, reader.problems[0].position)
                offset = bitio.power_two(slot - 1) + extra
            copied := copy_match(output, offset + 1, symbol - 253, original)
            if copied.kind != ""
                return copied
            output = copied.data
    return DecodeResult(output)

DecodeResult decode(int method, int[] payload, int original, int offset_bits, int length_bits)
    if method == 0
        if int(#payload) < original
            return DecodeResult([], "end_of_data", int(#payload))
        return DecodeResult(payload[0:<original])
    if method == 1
        result := lzw.decode(payload, original)
        if #result.problems > 0
            return DecodeResult([], result.problems[0].kind, result.problems[0].position)
        return DecodeResult(result.data)
    if method == 2
        return decode_lz(payload, original, offset_bits, length_bits)
    if method == 3
        return decode_lzh(payload, original, offset_bits, length_bits)
    result := arithmetic.decode(payload, original)
    if #result.problems > 0
        return DecodeResult([], result.problems[0].kind, result.problems[0].position)
    return DecodeResult(result.data)

class Encoding(string name, int[] data, int[][] payloads, int best, int[] lzw_stats, int[] lz_stats, int[] lzh_stats, int[] slots, int[] arith_stats)
    payload := payloads[best]

Encoding encode_file(string name, int[] data, Params params)
    tokens := lz77.tokenize(data, params.offset_bits, params.length_bits)
    zw := lzw.encode(data)
    lz_payload := encode_lz(tokens, params.offset_bits, params.length_bits)
    zh := encode_lzh(tokens, params)
    arith := arithmetic.encode(data)
    payloads := [data, zw.data, lz_payload, zh.data, arith.data]
    best := 0
    for: 1 <= method < 5
        if #payloads[method] < #payloads[best]
            best = method
    stats := [int(#tokens), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    for token := tokens[]
        if token.literal >= 0
            stats[1] += 1
        else
            stats[2] += 1
            stats[3] += token.length
            if token.length > stats[4]
                stats[4] = token.length
            if token.distance > stats[5]
                stats[5] = token.distance
    return Encoding(name, data, payloads, best, zw.stats, stats, zh.stats, zh.slots, arith.stats)

int[] uint_bytes(int value, int count)
    result := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for: count - 1 >= index >= 0
        result[index] = value % 256
        value /= 256
    return result

int read_uint(int[] data, int position, int count)
    result := 0
    for: index < count
        result = result * 256 + data[position + index]
    return result

int[] build_archive(Encoding[] encodings, Params params)
    result := [84, 88, 65, 82, params.offset_bits, params.length_bits]
    result = result.concat(uint_bytes(int(#encodings), 2))
    for encoded := encodings[]
        header := [int(#encoded.name)]
        header = header.concat(encoded.name.codepoints()).append(encoded.best)
        header = header.concat(uint_bytes(int(#encoded.data), 4))
        header = header.concat(uint_bytes(int(#encoded.payload), 4)).concat(uint_bytes(adler(encoded.data), 4))
        check := 0
        for value := header[]
            check = (check + value) % 256
        result = result.concat(header).append(check).concat(encoded.payload)
    return result

bool valid_name(int[] name)
    if #name < 1 or #name > 32
        return false
    allowed := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._-".codepoints()
    for value := name[]
        found := false
        for candidate := allowed[]
            if candidate == value
                found = true
        if not found
            return false
    return true

class Entry(int number, int offset)
    status := ""
    valid_header := false
    name := ""
    method := 0
    original := 0
    compressed := 0
    checksum := 0
    start := 0
    finish := 0
    int[] data := []
    computed := 0
    failure_kind := ""
    failure_position := 0
    int[] repair := []

class Parsed(int size)
    offset_bits := 0
    length_bits := 0
    declared := 0
    Entry[] entries := []
    Entry[] intact := []
    reason := ""
    stopped := false
    trailing := 0

Parsed parse_archive(int[] archive)
    parsed := Parsed(int(#archive))
    magic := [84, 88, 65, 82]
    if #archive < 8 or archive[0:<4] != magic
        parsed.reason = "bad_magic"
        return parsed
    parsed.offset_bits = archive[4]
    parsed.length_bits = archive[5]
    if parsed.offset_bits < 6 or parsed.offset_bits > 12 or parsed.length_bits < 2 or parsed.length_bits > 5
        parsed.reason = "bad_params"
        return parsed
    parsed.declared = read_uint(archive, 6, 2)
    position := 8
    for: 1 <= number <= parsed.declared
        entry := Entry(number, position)
        if position >= int(#archive) or position + 15 + archive[position] > int(#archive)
            entry.status = "truncated"
            parsed.entries = parsed.entries.append(entry)
            parsed.stopped = true
            break
        length := archive[position]
        name := archive[position + 1:<position + 1 + length]
        cursor := position + 1 + length
        start := position + 15 + length
        entry.method = archive[cursor]
        entry.original = read_uint(archive, cursor + 1, 4)
        entry.compressed = read_uint(archive, cursor + 5, 4)
        entry.checksum = read_uint(archive, cursor + 9, 4)
        entry.start = start
        entry.finish = start + entry.compressed
        check := 0
        for: position <= index < start - 1
            check = (check + archive[index]) % 256
        entry.valid_header = valid_name(name) and check == archive[start - 1]
        if not entry.valid_header
            entry.status = "bad_header"
            parsed.entries = parsed.entries.append(entry)
            position = entry.finish
            if position > int(#archive)
                parsed.stopped = true
                break
            continue
        entry.name = byte_text(name)
        if entry.finish > int(#archive)
            entry.status = "truncated"
            parsed.entries = parsed.entries.append(entry)
            parsed.stopped = true
            break
        if entry.method >= 5
            entry.status = "unsupported"
        else
            decoded := decode(entry.method, archive[start:<entry.finish], entry.original, parsed.offset_bits, parsed.length_bits)
            if decoded.kind != ""
                entry.status = "error"
                entry.failure_kind = decoded.kind
                entry.failure_position = decoded.position
            else
                entry.data = decoded.data
                entry.computed = adler(decoded.data)
                if entry.computed == entry.checksum
                    entry.status = "ok"
                else
                    repairs := repair_byte(decoded.data, entry.checksum, entry.computed)
                    if #repairs > 0
                        repaired := repairs[0]
                        entry.status = "repaired"
                        entry.data = repaired.data
                        entry.repair = repaired.record
                    else
                        entry.status = "checksum"
        parsed.entries = parsed.entries.append(entry)
        if entry.status == "ok" or entry.status == "repaired"
            parsed.intact = parsed.intact.append(entry)
        position = entry.finish
    if not parsed.stopped
        parsed.trailing = int(#archive) - position
    return parsed

int[] verify(int[] archive, Encoding[] encodings)
    parsed := parse_archive(archive)
    verified := 0
    for: index < int(#parsed.entries)
        entry := parsed.entries[index]
        if index < int(#encodings) and entry.status == "ok" and entry.data == encodings[index].data
            verified += 1
    return [int(#parsed.entries), verified]

string hex_value(int value, int width)
    if width <= 0
        return ""
    low := nat(value % 16 ^ width)
    hex := low.b16
    return "0" * (width - #hex) + hex

string[] sizes_report(Encoding[] encodings, Params params, int[] archive, int[] verified)
    lines := ["params offset_bits {params.offset_bits} length_bits {params.length_bits} window {bitio.power_two(params.offset_bits)} lookahead {bitio.power_two(params.length_bits) + 2} max_code_length {params.max_code_length}"]
    totals := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    chosen := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    original_total := 0
    best_total := 0
    names := method_names()
    for encoded := encodings[]
        original := int(#encoded.data)
        original_total += original
        best_total += int(#encoded.payload)
        chosen[encoded.best] += 1
        line := "file {encoded.name} original {original}"
        for: method < 5
            compressed := int(#encoded.payloads[method])
            totals[method] += compressed
            line += " " + names[method] + " {compressed} " + ratio(compressed, original)
        lines = lines.append(line + " best " + method_name(encoded.best))
    total_line := "total original {original_total}"
    chosen_line := "chosen"
    for: method < 5
        total_line += " " + names[method] + " {totals[method]} " + ratio(totals[method], original_total)
        chosen_line += " " + names[method] + " {chosen[method]}"
    total_line += " best {best_total} " + ratio(best_total, original_total)
    return lines.concat([total_line, chosen_line, "archive bytes {#archive} entries {#encodings} ratio " + ratio(int(#archive), original_total), "verify entries {verified[0]} ok {verified[1]}"])

string[] analysis_report(Encoding[] encodings)
    string[] lines := []
    for encoded := encodings[]
        zw := encoded.lzw_stats
        z := encoded.lz_stats
        zh := encoded.lzh_stats
        arith := encoded.arith_stats
        mode := if zh[8] == 0 then "fixed" else "dynamic"
        lines = lines.append("lzw {encoded.name} codes {zw[0]} clears {zw[1]} widths " + integers(zw[2:<6]) + " longest {zw[6]}")
        lines = lines.append("lz77 {encoded.name} tokens {z[0]} literals {z[1]} matches {z[2]} matched {z[3]} longest {z[4]} farthest {z[5]}")
        lines = lines.append("lzh {encoded.name} mode {mode} fixed_bits {zh[0]} table_bits {zh[1]} code_bits {zh[2]} halvings {zh[3]} litlen_used {zh[4]} litlen_max {zh[5]} offset_used {zh[6]} offset_max {zh[7]}")
        lines = lines.append("slots {encoded.name} " + integers(encoded.slots))
        lines = lines.append("arith {encoded.name} bits {arith[0]} contexts {arith[1]} rescales {arith[2]}")
    return lines

string[] listing_report(Parsed parsed)
    if parsed.reason != ""
        return ["archive bytes {parsed.size} error {parsed.reason}"]
    lines := ["archive bytes {parsed.size} offset_bits {parsed.offset_bits} length_bits {parsed.length_bits} entries {parsed.declared}"]
    int[][] totals := array(5, fill = array(3, fill = 0))
    listed := 0
    for entry := parsed.entries[]
        prefix := "entry {entry.number} offset {entry.offset}"
        if not entry.valid_header
            lines = lines.append(prefix + (if entry.status == "bad_header" then " bad_header" else " truncated header"))
            continue
        listed += 1
        lines = lines.append(prefix + " method " + method_name(entry.method) + " original {entry.original} compressed {entry.compressed} ratio " + ratio(entry.compressed, entry.original) + " adler " + hex_value(entry.checksum, 8) + " name {entry.name}")
        if entry.method < 5
            totals[entry.method][0] += 1
            totals[entry.method][1] += entry.original
            totals[entry.method][2] += entry.compressed
    names := method_names()
    for: method < 5
        total := totals[method]
        lines = lines.append("method " + names[method] + " entries {total[0]} original {total[1]} compressed {total[2]} ratio " + ratio(total[2], total[1]))
    state := if parsed.stopped then "truncated" else "complete"
    return lines.append("end listed {listed} of {parsed.declared} stop {state} trailing {parsed.trailing}")

string entry_test_line(Entry entry, int archive_size)
    prefix := "entry {entry.number} offset {entry.offset}"
    if not entry.valid_header
        return prefix + " status " + (if entry.status == "bad_header" then "bad_header" else "truncated header")
    line := prefix + " name {entry.name} method " + method_name(entry.method) + " status {entry.status}"
    if entry.status == "repaired"
        line += " byte {entry.repair[0]} from {entry.repair[1]} to {entry.repair[2]}"
    elif entry.status == "checksum"
        line += " stored " + hex_value(entry.checksum, 8) + " computed " + hex_value(entry.computed, 8)
    elif entry.status == "error"
        line += " {entry.failure_kind} at {entry.failure_position}"
    elif entry.status == "truncated"
        line += " payload have {archive_size - entry.start} need {entry.compressed}"
    return line

string[] test_report(Parsed parsed, Encoding[] encodings, int[] salvaged, int verified)
    string[] lines := []
    if parsed.reason != ""
        lines = ["archive error {parsed.reason}"]
    else
        names := status_names()
        counts := array(7, fill = 0)
        for entry := parsed.entries[]
            lines = lines.append(entry_test_line(entry, parsed.size))
            for: status < 7
                if entry.status == names[status]
                    counts[status] += 1
        line := "summary entries {parsed.declared} checked {#parsed.entries}"
        for: status < 7
            line += " " + names[status] + " {counts[status]}"
        lines = lines.append(line + " missing {parsed.declared - int(#parsed.entries)} trailing {parsed.trailing}")
    original := 0
    for: index < int(#encodings)
        encoded := encodings[index]
        entry := parsed.intact[index]
        original += int(#encoded.data)
        lines = lines.append("salvage {entry.name} method " + method_name(encoded.best) + " compressed {#encoded.payload} was " + method_name(entry.method) + " {entry.compressed}")
    return lines.append("salvaged entries {#encodings} bytes {#salvaged} original {original} verified {verified}")

string[] text_lines(int[] data)
    text := byte_text(data)
    lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

string[] extraction_report(Entry[] entries)
    string[] lines := []
    for entry := entries[]
        contents := text_lines(entry.data)
        words := 0
        longest := 0
        for line := contents[]
            if int(#line) > longest
                longest = int(#line)
            for word := line.split(" ")[]
                if word != ""
                    words += 1
        lines = lines.append("file {entry.name} bytes {#entry.data} lines {#contents} words {words} longest {longest}")
        lines = lines.concat(contents)
    return lines

class Edits(string[] lines, int removed, int added)

Edits edit_list(string[] old, string[] fresh)
    old_count := int(#old)
    new_count := int(#fresh)
    below := array(nat(new_count + 1), fill = 0)
    current := below
    decisions := array(nat(old_count), fill = bin.fill(nat(new_count), 0))
    for: old_count - 1 >= first >= 0
        deleted := bin.fill(nat(new_count), 0)
        right := 0
        for: new_count - 1 >= second >= 0
            length := 0
            if old[first] == fresh[second]
                length = below[second + 1] + 1
            elif below[second] >= right
                length = below[second]
                deleted[second] = bin(true)
            else
                length = right
            current[second] = length
            right = length
        decisions[first] = deleted
        saved := below
        below = current
        current = saved
    first := 0
    second := 0
    string[] edits := []
    removed := 0
    added := 0
    while first < old_count or second < new_count
        if first < old_count and second < new_count and old[first] == fresh[second]
            first += 1
            second += 1
            continue
        deletion := second == new_count
        if not deletion and first < old_count
            recorded := bool(decisions[first][second])
            deletion = recorded
        if deletion
            edits = edits.append("-{first + 1}:" + old[first])
            first += 1
            removed += 1
        else
            edits = edits.append("+{second + 1}:" + fresh[second])
            second += 1
            added += 1
    return Edits(edits, removed, added)

class InputFile(string name, int[] data)

string[] comparison_report(Entry[] entries, InputFile[] files)
    seen := array(#files, fill = false)
    string[] lines := []
    for entry := entries[]
        chosen := -1
        for: index < int(#files)
            if files[index].name == entry.name
                chosen = index
                break
        if chosen < 0
            lines = lines.append("archive_only {entry.name}")
            continue
        seen[chosen] = true
        old := text_lines(entry.data)
        fresh := text_lines(files[chosen].data)
        if entry.data == files[chosen].data
            lines = lines.append("same {entry.name} lines {#old}")
            continue
        first := 0
        while first < int(#old) and first < int(#fresh) and old[first] == fresh[first]
            first += 1
        edits := edit_list(old, fresh)
        lines = lines.append("differs {entry.name} first_line {first + 1} archive_lines {#old} manifest_lines {#fresh} removed {edits.removed} added {edits.added}")
        lines = lines.concat(edits.lines)
    for: index < int(#files)
        if not seen[index]
            lines = lines.append("new " + files[index].name)
    return lines

void save(string name, string[] lines)
    content := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(content)

string[] hex_lines(int[] data)
    string[] lines := []
    for: start < int(#data) step 32
        end := if start + 32 < int(#data) then start + 32 else int(#data)
        line := ""
        for: start <= index < end
            line += hex_value(data[index], 2)
        lines = lines.append(line)
    return lines

int[] parse_hex(string text)
    digits := text.codepoints()
    int[] values := []
    for: index < int(#digits) step 2
        first := if digits[index] <= 57 then digits[index] - 48 else digits[index] - 87
        second := if digits[index + 1] <= 57 then digits[index + 1] - 48 else digits[index + 1] - 87
        values = values.append(16 * first + second)
    return values

manifest := read_lines("input/manifest.txt")
params := Params(decimal(manifest[0].split(" ")[1]), decimal(manifest[1].split(" ")[1]), decimal(manifest[2].split(" ")[1]))
InputFile[] files := []
Encoding[] encodings := []
for: 3 <= index < int(#manifest)
    name := manifest[index].split(" ")[1]
    data := read_bytes("input/files/" + name)
    files = files.append(InputFile(name, data))
    encodings = encodings.append(encode_file(name, data, params))
created := build_archive(encodings, params)
verified := verify(created, encodings)
hexadecimal := read_lines("input/archive.hex").join("")
parsed := parse_archive(parse_hex(hexadecimal))
salvage_params := if parsed.reason != "" then params else Params(parsed.offset_bits, parsed.length_bits, params.max_code_length)
Encoding[] salvage_encodings := []
for entry := parsed.intact[]
    salvage_encodings = salvage_encodings.append(encode_file(entry.name, entry.data, salvage_params))
salvaged := build_archive(salvage_encodings, salvage_params)
salvage_verified := verify(salvaged, salvage_encodings)
output_exists := file.is_directory("output")
if not output_exists
    file.mkdir("output")
save("sizes.txt", sizes_report(encodings, params, created, verified))
save("analysis.txt", analysis_report(encodings))
save("archive.hex", hex_lines(created))
save("listing.txt", listing_report(parsed))
save("test_report.txt", test_report(parsed, salvage_encodings, salvaged, salvage_verified[1]))
save("extracted.txt", extraction_report(parsed.intact))
save("compare.txt", comparison_report(parsed.intact, files))
save("salvaged.hex", hex_lines(salvaged))
